E1.name: attributable
E1.note: no identity is captured; the shell user is whoever ran it

E2.name: timestamped
E2.note: nothing records when this ran unless the operator notes it

E3.name: tamper-evident
E3.note: stdout can be edited afterwards and nothing detects it

E4.name: complete inputs
E4.note: geometry, basis and active space are fixed in this file

E6.name: re-verifiable
E6.note: a third party must trust the operator's copy of the output

E7.name: append-only trail
E7.note: no audit record of any kind is written
